name: 19136 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19136 (Philadelphia) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19136 (Philadelphia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19136 (Philadelphia) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 health care organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
